table.name: TLGNS_SAP_BP_SAREA
table.description: Sales Area Data of a Business Partner as received from SAP in Sales Area Data data segment (KNVV_...) in BP interface.

column.name: SAP_BP_SAREA_ID
column.description: PK. Technical key generated by Logon, does not have a corresponding attribute in SAP.

column.name: SAP_BP_ID
column.description: FK tlgns_sap_bp. The business-partner to which this Sales Area Data belongs to. (SAP: KNA1_KUNNR, mapped)

column.name: SAREA_ID
column.description: FK TLGNC_SAREA. The sales area. (SAP: VKORG+VTWEG+SPART, mapped).

column.name: LAST_SUCCESSFUL_HJID
column.description: Contains the hjid of the most recent successfully imported notification or null in case the most recent one has failed. Non-enforced FK to ULGNSAP.BPN_BUSINESSPARTNERNOTIFICAT_0.

column.name: LAST_FAILED_HJID
column.description: Contains the hjid of the most recent notification for which the import has failed or null in case the most recent one was successful. Non-enforced FK to ULGNSAP.BPN_BUSINESSPARTNERNOTIFICAT_0.

column.name: REF_SAP_BP_SAREA_ID
column.description: FK to tlgns_sap_bp_sarea. If this is a dependent entry (common division and sales area), reference to the reference entry.

column.name: MARKED_FOR_DELETION
column.description: Deletion code in SAP (KNVV_LOEVM). 0=active, 1=deleted. Note that Logon normally has active_flag, with inversed logic. We stick to SAP standards in the tlgns_sap_... tables.

column.name: SALES_DISTRICT
column.description: Sales District in SAP (KNVV_BZIRK). Expected only for Ship-To. Currently no logic in Logon but may be used for authorization and reporting.

column.name: SOFFICE_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_soffice_bs. The Sales Office in SAP (KNVV_VKBUR).

column.name: SGROUP_CD
column.description: FK to tlgnr_sgroup_bs. The Sales Group in SAP (KNVV_VKGRP).

column.name: CUSTOMER_GROUP
column.description: Customer Group in SAP (KNVV_KDGRP). Expected for any BP type. Used in sales order for reporting purposes.

column.name: CUSTOMER_GROUP_4
column.description: Customer condition group 4 (SAP: KNVV_KVGR4). Currently no logic in Logon.

column.name: ABC_CLASS
column.description: ABC Class in SAP (KNVV_KLABC). Expected for Sold-To and Bill-To. Currently no logic in Logon.

column.name: CURRENCY_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_currency_bs. Currency from SAP (KNVV_WAERS). Expected for any BP type. Currently no logic in Logon, only storing the value.

column.name: DISTRIBUTION_DEST_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_distribution_dest_bs. Distribution Destination type (outbound, interunit prod., interunit distribution). (SAP: KNVV_KVGR5, mapping via tlgnr_map_kvgr5_distribdest_bs). Logon EBM 2.0: Value is no longer maintained in SAP => value is always set to 'OUT' by sapimport_bpn. The REAL value must be set by a masterdata admin in the dispocard, see tlgnc_shipto_sarea.distribution_dest_cd.

column.name: CUSTOMER_ORDER_BLOCK
column.description: Customer Order Block in SAP (KNVV_AUFSD). Expected for Sold-To only. If set, Logon will display a warning, possibly even forbid creating an order.

column.name: CUSTOMER_DELIVERY_BLOCK
column.description: Customer Delivery Block in SAP (KNVV_LIFSD). Expected for Sold-To only. If set, Logon will display warning, possibly forbid disposition.

column.name: CUSTOMER_POSTING_BLOCK
column.description: Customer Posting Block in SAP (KNVV_FAKSD). Expected for Sold - To only. If set, Logon will display warning, possibly forbid disposition.

column.name: CUSTOM_OFFICE
column.description: Custom Office in SAP (KNVV-ZZAZOLL). Currently no logic in Logon, not even clear for which BP-types expected. Possibly used later in Delivery Note / Parallel interface.

column.name: DEFAULT_PLANT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_plant_bs. Default Plant in SAP (KNVV_VWERK). Expected only for Ship-To.
